$comment: Shared behavioral contract for every trackstack-auth-client implementation (this Python package, and trackstack-ui's Node /auth-client subpath). Each implementation's own test suite loads this file and asserts identical behavior against it, so the two can't silently drift the way finance-tracker and nutrition-insights's hand-copied PAT fallbacks did before either had one at all. Keep this file byte-identical across both repos -- if the fixture ever needs to change, update it in both places in the same commit/session.
$behavior: Given validJwt: verify locally against jwtSecret/jwtAlgorithm, return expectedFromValidJwt. Must NOT call trackstackAuthUrl at all for this case.
Given malformedToken with no trackstackAuthUrl configured: return null without attempting any network call.

Given patToken (not a valid JWT) with trackstackAuthUrl configured: local JWT verification fails, then POST {trackstackAuthUrl}/tokens/verify with body patVerifyRequest; a mocked 200 response with patVerifyResponseBody must yield expectedFromPat.
Given revokedPatToken with trackstackAuthUrl configured: local JWT verification fails, then POST /tokens/verify; a mocked non-2xx (e.g. 401) response must yield null, not throw.
Given trackstackAuthUrl unreachable (connection error) on the PAT fallback path: return null, not throw or crash the caller's request.
